items.name: Spec compliance
items.note: Goal: SBOM resolves every dependency license. All 46 direct deps now resolve via detect_npm_license (was 40/46). No FR changes; Spec Impact NONE (dependency metadata only).

items.name: Security basics
items.note: No version, resolved URL or integrity hash changed; only 6 license string fields added, values taken from `npm view <pkg>@<locked version> license` (MIT x4, ISC, Apache-2.0). No copyleft introduced.

items.name: Test quality
items.note: No new behavior to test; behavior_snapshot verify green->green (40 files / 377 tests).

items.name: Performance basics
items.note: Lockfile metadata does not affect the bundle; installed tree identical (npm ci succeeded with same versions).

items.name: Naming & structure
items.note: File is npm-normalized: npm install --package-lock-only round-trips it byte-identically, so future installs will not strip or reorder the fields.

items.name: Affected boundaries
items.note: Boundary: package-lock.json consumed by npm ci (CI + local) and the Shipwright SBOM collector. Both verified: npm ci ok, collector resolves 46/46.
